title: The Turku node (which one?)
description: The ticket only says 'the Turku node' and Turku has two sites (Kupittaa exchange and the harbour hut). Colleagues narrow it down in the chat. Tests disambiguation: the knowledge must bind to TRN-042 only, not to the site's other elements and not to the new TX-5000 in the harbour hut.
subject: Turku node: management port after power cycle

messages.text: hey, quick one. the Turku node was power cycled this morning after the maintenance window and I still can't reach its management port
should I just cycle it again?
Which one? Turku has Kupittaa and the harbour hut.
hmm. the ticket just says 'Turku node'. veikko you were there last week right?
yes the old one, Kupittaa 👍 the harbour hut one is the new TX-5000, they only put that in last year
ah ok so that's TRN-042 then
Hm. Then don't cycle it again. The 3.8 boxes need around 8 minutes after a cold start before the management port answers. Traffic is fine in the meantime.
oh that explains why it looked dead when I stood in front of it last time
port is back, took 9 min. as you said

items.summary: After a power cycle TRN-042 (firmware 3.8) needs about 8 minutes before its management port answers; traffic is not affected, so do not cycle it again.
items.diagnosis: management port is slow to come up after a cold start, the unit is not stuck
items.action: Wait about 8 to 10 minutes after a power cycle before checking the management port.
items.evidence: seq 10: 'port is back, took 9 min. as you said'
